title: [Bug] Auto-Compact Fails Due to Conversation Length Limit
body:

it fails to compact saying "Error: Error during compaction: Error: Conversation too long. Press esc twice to go up a few messages and try 
    again." often. its happened at single digit % and 0% and refuses to move foward. it doesn't even autocompact

**Environment Info**

- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 2.0.2

top_comments.body:
Can't Claude Code just have some smart fallback strategy?

e.g.:

* if Error(context_too_long); then combine( compact(first 90%)  , compact(last 90%) ) 
* if Still Error(context_too_long); then combine ( compact(first 80%), compact(last 80%))
* (...)

sounds like trivial workaround, not perfect, but better then annoying error happening so often... and ofc if rootcause would be addressed still having this fallback , only makes system more resilient and self recoverable in case of regression in th
